title: Abstract 3-SAT instance for state-change design
description: An abstract 3-SAT formula that must be encoded into a patchy-particle system by the competitor. This problem contains only the logical structure (variables and clauses), not a fixed molecular encoding.

sat_instance.convention: Each clause is a list of 3 integers. Positive k means variable k, negative k means NOT variable k.

simulation_constraints.notes: Competitors are free to choose patch types, geometry, and interactions, subject to these global resource limits.

expected_decode.tolerance: The decoded assignment must satisfy all clauses of the formula. We will verify independently.

scoring.description: Lower work (number of state-change events or an equivalent energy measure) per satisfied clause is better.
